        "title": "The Best Time of Day to Take Vitamin B12 for Maximum Absorption, According to Dietitians",
        "content": "The red blood cells that course through your veins, the protective covering that surrounds your nerve fibers and the genetic information that is tightly packed into your cells all rely on one key nutrient—vitamin B12. Yet nearly 12.5% of the people in the U.S. aged 19 or older are not getting enough of this essential vitamin.1 This is particularly common among older adults, people who follow a vegetarian or vegan diet and individuals with certain digestive disorders. If you fall into one of these groups, you may have been advised to take a vitamin B12 supplement. However, in order to unlock your supplement’s full potential, timing may be just as important as the supplement itself.
